description: Time zone setting (country and zone, or a fixed GMT offset) with a live clock in Settings

usage: formatTime(new Date())   // 3 Oct 2026, 18:30:00 in the chosen zone
Set it in Settings > Time zone. Store timestamps in UTC and format them with formatTime().
format_time()            # 03 Oct 2026, 18:30:00 in the chosen zone
Set it in Settings > Time zone. Store timestamps in UTC and format them with format_time().
